name: Nagamachi Yae
source:
Yae is very athletic and always full of energy. Searching in the tunnel at the basement of the school has become a hobby of hers recently, and she guides students who find themselves lost in the tunnels to the exit. When she goes underground, Yae wears a rabbit costume.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
